Chapter 7010: Snowdragon Immortal

Chapter 7010: Snowdragon Immortal

“Retreat!” Till Ancestor and Amethyst Immortal became the defenders of this land, forcing the attackers back.

Their combined efforts changed the landscape outside the ancestral ground. Stars shattered and void zones were formed.

“Must it be to the death?” River God and Hatred Lord became annoyed.

“That depends on your ability.” Amethyst focused on pushing Golden Machine Immortal back while still shouting.

“You must get through us!” Till Ancestor swung his hoe rapidly, forcing the crowd back.

Other immortals finally joined the fight. One of them swung a ruyi staff, another spewed an inferno at Till Ancestor.

Amethyst noticed the dire situation and wanted to save Till Ancestor. Alas, the fortress grew larger and blocked his way.

“Rumble!” This ended with Till Ancestor being nearly pulverized.

“Till Ancestor, it is not too late to leave!” River God shouted.

“Come.” Till Ancestor entered a frenzy, wanting to smash other immortals. His swing was fast enough to form tornadoes to trap the enemies.

“You court death!” The crowd was furious since they were affected as well.

Thus, they joined River God and Hatred Lord in the battle.

“Scram!” An icy power suddenly erupted and froze the attacking immortals.

A beauty walked out of the storm. Alas, no one had time to appreciate her power since they were preoccupied with surviving the blizzard.

“Senior, are you alright?” She propped Till Ancestor up.

“I’m fine.” He struggled to stand straight. Speaking caused him to vomit blood.

“Snowdragon Immortal.” Other immortals kept a distance from this golden immortal belonging to Foreign Alliance.

Rumor has it she was a special-breed ice dragon. Due to her unique blood and power, she was considered an aberration, subjected to discrimination.

Fortunately, she met Till Ancestor and received his guidance. Finally, she became an immortal and even surpassed him.

Although she wasn’t as powerful as Breaker Immortal, she had a similar fiery temperament. Of course, she didn’t destroy worlds and only fought immortals.

“If it’s a fight you want, bring it. Come together.” She spoke while releasing a torrential power. This was her style even before becoming a golden immortal.

“Boom!” Amethyst broke through the wall and made it back to the ancestral ground and said: “Count me in.”

“Crack!” Golden Machine Immortal had a hole in its wall but quickly reassembled to perfection.

“Don’t get cocky now.” It spoke and delivered a message.

“Rumble!” The sky turned dark as another fortress appeared.

“Who dares to compete against our race?” The fortress had a silver light, allowing others to recognize him.

“This place belongs to us alone.” Golden Machine Immortal gathered energy.

“That’s Silver Machine Immortal.” Someone from their world said.

These two were brothers - something truly rare among immortals. The question was, how were they born? Everything about their race was shrouded in mystery.
